title: Unit 34 Consolidation: Slang, Register Shifting & Living Language

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can fluently navigate between Hungarian slang, colloquial expressions, and formal registers
I can correctly deploy expressive twin-words like gizgaz, limlom, csecsebecse, and hercehurca
I can appreciate and produce Hungarian conversational humor, irony, and communicative tags
